svg.title: Restaurant Finder — application and AWS architecture
svg.desc: The local Chainlit UI calls an ARM64 backend on AWS AgentCore Runtime. Input moderation and Jev routing, with a Bedrock fallback, select search, document RAG or simple responses. Search calls AgentCore Gateway, Lambda and external SearchAPI. Custom document RAG uses Titan V2, S3 Vectors and versioned S3 chunks. All workflow responses receive final moderation before approved conversation memory writes and delivery. The local source viewer separately retrieves and hash-verifies original PDFs from private S3. Deployment uses CDK and ECR; OpenTelemetry exports telemetry to CloudWatch. Optional browser and hybrid retrieval are labeled.

text.tspan: From a local chat interface to an agent backend deployed on AWS

Generation + routing fallback; guardrails are configurable.
results before delivery and durable turn writes.
Separate UI read · generation-specific key + SHA-256 check
Explicit build / push / release · document ingestion is separate from live restaurant search.
Correlated spans, logs and metrics · export setup required
Solid arrows: request / service call Dashed arrows: external classification or source inspection Overview of supported paths; optional features need configuration.
